title: NYC Daily Digest
text:
Good morning, Matthew - Tuesday, September 8, 2026

WEATHER
Sunny and mild. Currently 65F, climbing to a high near 81F, low around 69F tonight. No rain - light NW winds. T-shirt weather; grab shades, no jacket needed.

HEADLINES
- Amazon cargo jet overshot a runway at Miami Int'l, tore through a fence onto a road - 5 killed, 3 critical; investigators on scene.
- Germany: far-right AfD wins ~44% in Saxony-Anhalt state vote; Chancellor Merz says the result has "shaken" his CDU.
- Oil hits a 6-week high as US-Iran strikes escalate - a Saudi Aramco facility reportedly hit after US strikes on Iranian tankers.
- Nepal in mourning after historic flooding; rescue efforts continue.
- AI in the spotlight: Seattle Times sues Microsoft/OpenAI over training data; Anthropic's Claude can now run lab experiments autonomously.

GETTING AROUND
Mostly normal for a weekday. Overnight only: G train skips 4 Av-9 St, 15 St-Prospect Park & Fort Hamilton Pkwy (10:45pm-5am) for signal work. Q still running the 96 St-Brighton Beach pattern with B109 shuttle buses to Coney Island.

NYC TODAY
It's NYFW week - Ann Taylor's running an immersive SoHo pop-up today. And Christie's at 20 Rock opens a free public exhibition of costumes & jewelry from The Devil Wears Prada 2 (through Sept 13).

NUGGET
New research suggests exercise may reshape the brain's emotional networks, not just its fitness - pointing toward workouts as a real tool in future mental-health care. One more reason for that midday walk.

Have a great Tuesday.
